skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and interpret large datasets to support business intelligence.
Create visual representations of data to aid in business decision-making.
Manage and integrate data from various sources into a cohesive database system.
Develop and implement business strategies based on data-driven insights.
Lead and manage projects related to business intelligence and data analytics.
Evaluate and solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
Work effectively in teams to achieve business intelligence goals.
Effectively communicate data insights and business intelligence findings.
Make ethical decisions in the context of business intelligence and data management.
Utilize software tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL Server for data analysis and visualization.
